links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI and website patient education materials on myringotomy tubes
links.effect: ChatGPT Flesch-Kincaid Grade Levels 13.1, 13.9, 15.7; Gemini 9.5, 12.4, 9.8; website mean grade 8; all above recommended 6th grade level.
links.quote: Sites and artificial intelligence providing patient education material regarding myringotomy tubes are of "fair" quality but have readability levels above the recommended 6th grade level.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient materials versus recommended 6th grade level
links.effect: Website mean FK Grade Level 8; ChatGPT 13.1-15.7 and Gemini 9.5-12.4 across domains, above 6th grade level; Google search results superior to AI in readability.
links.quote: Google search results were superior to artificial intelligence in readability.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of the quality (DISCERN) and readability of ChatGPT and Google Gemini patient education outputs against Google search results, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
